label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: No responderás en tu compañero testigo de mentira.
spanish: No responderás testigo de mentira contra tu compañero.
grammarChanges: Moved 'testigo de mentira' to follow 'responderás' directly as its complement, instead of leaving it right after 'tu compañero', so it no longer reads as an apposition describing the companion.
Replaced the calque 'en' before 'tu compañero' with 'contra', since ב with the qal of ענה marks the one testified against, not a location inside the companion.
